name: Ernest
description: A Crest long lost to history. Occasionally stops enemy counterattacks when using a weapon.

name: Macuil
description: Legend has it that Saint Macuil bore this Crest. A symbol of magic and mastery of the wind. Occasionally raises Mt during magic attacks.

name: Seiros
description: Legend has it that Saint Seiros bore this Crest and passed it down through House Hresvelg. Occasionally raises Mt when using combat arts.

name: Dominic
description: House Dominic’s Crest, inherited from Dominic of the 10 Elites. Occasionally conserves uses of attack magic.
